card.name: Maintained and times in set phrases
card.fires_on: The word "maintained" after "patients" (e.g. patients maintained on hemodialysis), and "times" in "at times" or "at all times". Also the end of "maintain" when split across pieces.

modes.description: "maintained" right after "patients" or "currently", before "on" a therapy such as hemodialysis or a stable dose.

modes.label: At times
modes.description: "times" completing the phrase "at times" or "at all times".
modes.example: The user should wear waterproof gloves at all<< times>> when handling the capsules or container.

modes.label: Maintain split word
modes.description: The ending piece of "maintain" when the word is split.
modes.example: to assume or main t<<ain>> any attitudes.
